versions.notes:
Put your ideas into play: An improved Remix experience makes it easier to try a different take on the scene.
Explore other players’ twists: Browse their Remixes and play through the changes they imagined.
Earn rewards along the way: Collect Moons when you complete an episode for the first time, excluding the intro. Unlock more check-in rewards without losing progress if you miss a day.
Stay immersed: Refined dialogue presentation and interactions help each scene flow more naturally.

Improved the overall user experience
Fixed known issues
Enhanced app stability and performance

description: Lunaverse is an interactive story app where your choices shape branching drama, relationships, and outcomes. Explore episode-based stories, make decisions, pass checks, play short mini-games, and watch each route unfold through character-driven scenes. Start with romance, school-life, and high-stakes drama, track your progress, revisit saves, and discover how different choices change the story.
